dynamic_discovery_v5._peer_comp_comment: DV.V (Dolly Varden) removed 2026-06-05: delisted from TSXV 2026-03-27 on the merger into Contango (CTGO, NYSE American). A delisted ticker returns no live price, so it was already SILENTLY dropping out of the EV/oz blend. Re-add CTGO here once its post-merger AgEq resource + stage are sourced into research_cache.

BRC.V._comment: Blackrock Silver / Tonopah West — the parcel adjacent to AGA.V (Hughes) and their SOLE focus, so further down the de-risking curve than AGA (pre-PEA). Stage corrected Explorer->PFS so stage-normalization DISCOUNTS its richer EV/oz down to AGA's frame instead of applying it raw. Ounces now sourced from research_cache (~21.1M M&I / 86.9M inferred AgEq); this registry oz is a stale fallback only.

stage_multipliers._comment: LEGACY (used only when stage_normalization_enabled=false). The active path uses peer_normalization.DEFAULT_STAGE_CURVE, a wider Lassonde de-risking curve; this flat block compressed a producer to ~1.3x an explorer, which is unrealistically narrow.

dynamic_discovery_v5._use_sourced_spear_oz_comment: Reconcile AGA.V's market-leg ounces to the SOURCED resource (research_cache): scale magnitude to filings and use the REAL sitewide M&I/inferred split instead of the per-project target_mi guesses. Per-project TQ preserved. False -> legacy config buckets.
dynamic_discovery_v5._target_stage_comment: Normalize every peer's EV/oz INTO this stage (AGA.V's frame) before blending: a more-advanced peer (BRC.V) is discounted down, a less-advanced one lifted up. = curve[target]/curve[peer]. Overridden by portfolio_metadata['AGA.V'].stage when present.

peer_relevance_weights._comment: Relevance weight per peer for the comp blend (replaces pure liquidity weighting, which could suppress the best comp). BRC.V is the adjacent prime comp -> full weight; others half.

technical_quality._comment: Phase 4a: transparent, bounded Technical-Quality multiplier so in-situ ounces are NOT fungible. TQ = clamp(product of per-factor bands). The M&I<->Inferred confidence haircut is deliberately NOT here (it lives in effective_oz) to avoid double-counting confidence. f_jurisdiction reads the REAL Fraser index (fixing the silver-price misnomer); f_metallurgy blends Ag+Au recovery on the AgEq split (fixing the dropped-gold bug).

option_premium._comment: Phase 4a: dimensionally-coherent option/convexity premium pi_opt (a FRACTION >= 0) applied MULTIPLICATIVELY to the market leg, replacing the dead additive ROV term and the mislabeled discovery_premium_factor. It captures convexity NOT already in the comps (peer EV/oz already prices the live silver level), so it is built from realized vol and monetary carry, plus a RELATIVE operating-leverage term (target vs peer/industry moneyness) that is ~0 with no AISC edge -> no double-count of the silver level. Decays by stage: an explorer IS an option; a producer is cash flows.

triangulation._comment: Phase 4a: confidence-tilted Cost+Market+Income triangulation. Final weights w_i = (W_i^stage * c_i) / sum_j(W_j^stage * c_j), so when comps go stale or ounces are Inferred-heavy weight shifts to the cost floor. Income leg is 0 for a pure explorer (optionality is folded into the market leg via 1+pi_opt).

scenarios._comment: Phase 4a: base/bull/bear triangulation range + one-at-a-time tornado over the dominant swing inputs. spot shift uses sigma_mult * annualized realized silver vol; peer_ev uses a placeholder pct band until a peer-EV history exists (Phase 5).

directive_thresholds._comment: Phase 4a: recalibrated to the de-inflated (double-count-removed) valuation scale. The high-conviction gate now reads the SPEAR's own intrinsic-vs-price upside (robust, intuitive) rather than the structurally-lower blended portfolio edge.

v5_guardrails._adv_comment: Phase 0 patch: the liquidity cap is denominated on a 90-session MEDIAN (or EWMA) of daily volume rather than a 10-day ADV. A 10-day average spikes during panics, pro-cyclically EXPANDING the dollar cap exactly when liquidity should be assumed scarcer; a 90d median cannot be moved by a single panic day.

allocation_directive._comment: Governs the over-allocation reporting metric and trim directives. The headline 'kelly_multiple' is the risk-adjusted target leverage f* (bounded [0, L_max]); 'allocation_ratio' = book / Kelly-target (the reciprocal of f*), CLAMPED to display_cap so an illiquid/low-edge (tiny) target cannot send it to infinity. trim_ratio fires the top-line OVER-ALLOCATED directive; caution_ratio fires the softer rebalancing priority.

ballast_valuation._comment: commodity is now correctly tagged per name (was all 'silver' — a bug): GROY=gold, URC=uranium, GMX=diversified. Drives the commodity tailwind + fair-value scaling. ref_price/spot_ref are legacy anchors; real book-value floors come from research_cache.

portfolio_metadata._comment: management_score (0-1) is an analyst execution/track-record input feeding the Conviction Mode Q pillar. archetype = valuation class (axis 1); subarchetype = finer sort WITHIN it (axis 3, archetypes.SUBARCHETYPE_DNA — display/correlation only until calibrated); sector_tags = orthogonal descriptive labels (metal/stage/structure/jurisdiction) for filtering. The commodity (axis 2) lives in ballast_valuation.

archetype_routing._comment: Phase 5 Polymorphic Archetype Factory: maps a portfolio_metadata 'type' to one of the five cash-flow-lifecycle archetypes. An explicit portfolio_metadata[ticker].archetype overrides this map. Archetypes: option_convexity (pre-revenue/binary), capital_margin (capital-intensive operating, incl. regulated/defense), commodity_cyclical (spot-margin dominated), asset_light_yield (recurring high-margin cash flow), pure_macro_delta (passive commodity vehicle).

archetype_factory._comment: Phase 5 tuning for the Polymorphic Archetype Factory (archetypes.py). All values are optional — the module falls back to its in-code defaults when this block is absent, so the legacy config keeps working untouched. base_currency is CAD; the FX hook normalizes every leg into it. weights are the stage (base) Cost/Market/Income leg weights; final weights are confidence-tilted w_i = (W_i*c_i)/sum_j(W_j*c_j). regime.sensitivity_default scales the bounded macro-asymmetry overlay clamp(1 + sensitivity*alpha, mult_floor, mult_ceiling).

regime_derivation._comment: Phase 5b Layer A: the macro -> RegimeImpactVector derivation, fully detached into config. Live signals (mri, real_yield, silver_vol, dxy_mom) are normalized to ~[-1,1] then linearly combined per archetype. EVERY key falls back to the in-code default shown here if absent/malformed, so behavior is identical to the prior hardcoded version until this block is actively tuned. Pivots double as center+scale; *_scale keys are pure denominators (guarded against zero). Signal keys usable in the alpha weight maps: risk_on, stress, neg_yield, vol_edge, weak_usd.

archetype_barbell_weights._comment: Phase 5b: anchor 60/15/15/10 barbell weights used to roll the per-name archetype intrinsics into one supplementary CAD book intrinsic (terminal_state.archetype_valuation_detail.barbell). Keys prefixed with _ are ignored.

conviction_mode._comment: Phase 7: the 0-10 T-Q-V Asymmetry Rating that drives the primary Conviction Mode view (asymmetry_rating.py). Every constant is overridable here; omit the block entirely to use module defaults. This view deliberately does NOT consume the diversified-book machinery (spear/position caps, ES95 throttle, covariance shrinkage, fractional-Kelly/VIX de-leveraging) — that stays in Detailed Analysis. T=Macro Tailwind, Q=Company Quality in a vacuum, V=Valuation Asymmetry (the heaviest pillar).

quality_lenses._comment: Junior-miner quality checklist for the Q pillar. Each lens is normalized to 0-1 across its band, then blended by these weights over whatever lenses have live data (renormalized). grade=head grade g/t AgEq; scale=contained effective AgEq oz; jurisdiction=real Fraser index; metallurgy=blended Ag+Au recovery; permitting=development stage.

commodity_weight_by_archetype._comment: Commodity-specific tailwind weight (gold/silver/uranium differ; royalties share the archetype lean). AUDITED for this terminal, reasoned not backtested — TUNE. kappa=archetype lean, this=commodity lean, remainder=raw MRI.

pillar_weights_by_archetype._comment: Per-archetype blend. Explorers: V (asymmetry) dominant + elevated T. Royalty/asset-light: Q (cash-flow quality) dominant, low T. Cyclical: balanced. V stays meaningful everywhere.

conviction_lift._comment: Non-linear lift toward the standout pillar (V for explorers scaled by floor support; max(Q,V) for cash-flow assets scaled by forensic cleanliness) so a strong, EARNED thesis can reach 8.5-9.5. Never exceeds the anchor pillar; gated so it can't inflate a premium or weak name.

forensic_gate._comment: Floor-aware gate. Caps are RELAXED toward 10 by floor support (price at/below the REP floor): a junior funding drilling while below liquidation value isn't slammed to 'avoid' — its asymmetry shines. Diluting/burning at a premium is fully gated; a genuinely broken balance sheet (very low JSF) stays a heavy penalty even below floor.

catalysts._comment: Phase 8 Live Catalyst & Signal Reactivity. catalyst_engine.py reads feed_path (written by ingestion_pipeline.refresh_catalyst_feed). Events are recency-weighted (half_life_days) into bounded TQV overlays: drill/grade/resource -> V scenario uplift (bull/base/p_discovery, capped) + a small Q echo; catalyst/permitting/news -> conviction (Q); permitting stage -> Q lens; financings -> dilution_velocity (forensic gate). Sources run in 'providers' order with primary/fallback dedup: edgar/sedar filings (authoritative, trust 3) supersede rss_news (breadth, trust 1) on financing/permitting/resource; catalyst_manual (trust 5) always wins. Disable with enabled:false.
catalysts._live_feed_note: use_live_feeds:true -> engine refreshes the feed from the providers below (EDGAR/RSS/manual CSV) on a live_refresh_seconds TTL, then serves the rewritten feed (no more static/hardcoded display). use_live_feeds:false -> serves EMPTY (unless serve_seed_when_disabled:true, which serves the on-disk seed for offline demos). NOTE: live RSS/EDGAR fetch only works if the environment's network policy allows the feed hosts (mining.com, data.sec.gov, etc.); when blocked, those providers fail gracefully and only the manual analyst CSV contributes.
catalysts._provider_order_note: PRIMARY = live feeds (edgar/sedar filings + marketaux symbol-tagged news + rss breadth), run first. catalyst_manual runs LAST and is a TRUE OVERRIDE: it carries the highest trust (5) so a verified manual row WINS a dedup conflict, but it is EMPTY by default so it never becomes the bulk of the feed. Trust (manual 5 > edgar/sedar 3 > marketaux 2 > rss 1) — not list order — decides conflicts; order here documents primary-vs-override intent.

params._alias_note: Use DISTINCTIVE company/project names (>=5 chars), NOT generic words like 'gold mining' which misattribute. Attribution requires whole-word matches and a relevance >= min_relevance; generic sector news stays unattributed.
params._feeds_note: Phase 7.2: GlobeNewswire industry feeds are FREE press-wire RSS (issuers' own releases, full company names -> better attribution than editorial feeds) and are reachable from datacenter egress. Dropped mining.com/tag/silver (404) and juniorminingnetwork (Cloudflare 403). Marketaux below adds exact symbol-tagged attribution for the Canadian names.

params._key_note: Free tier ~100 req/day; set the MARKETAUX_API_KEY env var (or params.api_key) to activate. Symbol-tagged: attributes by EXACT ticker (relevance 1.0), so it covers the Canadian TSX/TSX-V names that fuzzy headline matching misses. Graceful skip until a key is present. symbol_map maps portfolio ticker -> Marketaux symbol (adjust the suffix if Marketaux differs for TSX/TSX-V).

forensic_override_policy._comment: Manual forensic overrides are honored only if justified AND expiry is within this many days of today; longer-dated or unjustified waivers are ignored and the real test re-engages. Each active override is surfaced with requires_confirmation for confirm-on-use in the UI.

AGA.V.justification: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the real basis. Treasury funded through current program; share-count step-up assumed to be a single strategic placement and the cash-burn step-up the budgeted drill campaign, not deteriorating unit economics. Re-confirm before each run.

forensic_thresholds._cba_comment: Phase 0 patch: CBA is normalized against Enterprise Value (size proxy) instead of Total Cash, so micro-cap explorers running an intentionally lean treasury are not penalized by a small denominator. EV>>cash, so the gate moves from 0.15 (fraction of cash) to ~0.03 (fraction of EV); recalibrate against live EV. Falls back to cash-based 0.15 when EV is unavailable.

mri_dynamic_bounds._comment: Phase 0 patch: replaces hard-coded static min-max bounds in the MRI with a rolling percentile rank over a trailing window (default 5y). Static bounds permanently saturate at 0/100 once a price leaves the historic band (e.g. silver pinned at 100 in the $70+ regime); a rolling percentile against a CURRENT window keeps the signal live. Components not listed, or with fewer than min_obs cached observations, fall back to the existing static norm so the engine never blocks on a cold cache.

ingestion._comment: Phase 6 open-source ingestion (ingestion_pipeline.py). Providers are config-driven via ingestion_pipeline.ADAPTER_REGISTRY: add a new free source (e.g. polygon, alpha_vantage) by writing a @register_adapter BaseAdapter subclass and appending an entry here -- no pipeline/engine refactor. FRED uses the keyless fredgraph.csv endpoint. SEC EDGAR is US-filers-only, so capability_precedence falls back manual->sec->yfinance, and yfinance covers the TSX/TSX-V names (AGA.V/URC.TO/GMX.TO) that EDGAR does not. Sentiment is opt-in/best-effort with safe neutral defaults (no HTML scraping). The engine reads data/ingestion_cache.json in _archetype_payload and degrades gracefully (logging + _safe_leg) if it is missing or stale.

forge._comment: Forge layer tunables (Sentinel M3 + swap M6). Reasoned first calibration for a concentrated, thin-liquidity junior/multi-commodity book; editable via propose/confirm. The 60% structural ceiling is NOT here and is never loosened — liquidity_runway is an ADDITIONAL gate, never a relaxation.
